item.title: Fort William Invited to Shape its Own Transport Future
item.description: A public consultation has opened on the Fort William Integrated Transport Plan, inviting residents and businesses to shape proposals tackling congestion on the A82 and A830, public transport gaps and long term connectivity across Lochaber.The post Fort William Invited to Shape its Own Transport Future appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Households Face Higher Bills as Economy Slows and Unemployment Rises
item.description: The SNP has criticised the Chancellor’s spring statement after UK growth was downgraded to 1.1% and unemployment reached a five year high, warning that families across Scotland face continued cost of living pressures.The post Households Face Higher Bills as Economy Slows and Unemployment Rises appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Orkney Museum Brings Wartime Images Back To Life in Powerful New Exhibition
item.description: Orkney Museum is hosting ‘Recreating the Past Today’, a unique exhibition where the NHS Orkney Photo Group recreates World War Two images using authentic 1940s cameras, on display from 7 March to 11 April.The post Orkney Museum Brings Wartime Images Back To Life in Powerful New Exhibition appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Record Numbers Sign Up for 2026 Inverness Half Marathon
item.description: A record 5,100 runners will compete in the sold out 2026 Inverness Half Marathon and 5K on 8 March, with half of entrants female and thousands raising funds for Highland charities.The post Record Numbers Sign Up for 2026 Inverness Half Marathon appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Union Fury After BrewDog Sale Leaves Hundreds Facing Redundancy
item.description: Unite has criticised the handling of BrewDog’s sale to Tilray after 38 bars were announced to close and 484 jobs cut, raising concerns over consultation, transparency and redundancy rights. The post Union Fury After BrewDog Sale Leaves Hundreds Facing Redundancy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Police Appeal After Deliberate Fire at Inverness Property
item.description: Police are appealing for information after a deliberate fire at a property on Bught Drive in Inverness at 1am on 3 March 2026, with officers urging anyone with CCTV or dash cam footage to come forward.The post Police Appeal After Deliberate Fire at Inverness Property appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Jacobite Loch Ness Cruises Named Individual Attraction of The Year at UKinbound Awards for Excellence 2025
item.description: Jacobite Loch Ness Cruises has been named Individual Attraction of the Year at the UKinbound Awards for Excellence 2025 after welcoming more than 320,000 visitors in 2025.The post Jacobite Loch Ness Cruises Named Individual Attraction of The Year at UKinbound Awards for Excellence 2025 appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: New Lochaber Hospital Plan Now With Highland Council as Next Stage Moves Forward
item.description: NHS Highland’s planning application for the new 11,800 square metre Lochaber Hospital is now with Highland Council, with a decision expected by June as the Outline Business Case is finalised.The post New Lochaber Hospital Plan Now With Highland Council as Next Stage Moves Forward appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Harbour Side Cottage in The Heart of Kinlochbervie
item.description: Harbour Cottage in Kinlochbervie offers a three bedroom detached home with harbour views, wraparound garden and potential for additional accommodation, set in one of the most dramatic coastal locations in the northwest Highlands.The post A Harbour Side Cottage in The Heart of Kinlochbervie appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Western Isles Council Urges Rethink on Balivanich Bank Closure
item.description: Comhairle nan Eilean Siar is urging Bank of Scotland to reconsider plans to close its Balivanich branch, warning the move could harm communities across Uist and Benbecula. The post Western Isles Council Urges Rethink on Balivanich Bank Closure appeared first on The Highland Times.
